description: Declaration of the AdbEndpointObject class, which manages USB endpoint handles in the Android Debug Bridge (ADB) API, including methods for asynchronous and synchronous I/O operations, and endpoint information retrieval.

classes.name: AdbEndpointObject
classes.description: Represents a USB endpoint handle in the ADB API, providing methods for I/O operations and endpoint info.

methods.name: AdbEndpointObject
methods.description: Constructor initializing the endpoint object with parent interface, endpoint ID, and index.

methods.name: ~AdbEndpointObject
methods.description: Virtual destructor, hidden to prevent stack allocation.

methods.name: AsyncRead
methods.description: Performs asynchronous read from the endpoint.

methods.name: AsyncWrite
methods.description: Performs asynchronous write to the endpoint.

methods.name: SyncRead
methods.description: Performs synchronous read from the endpoint.

methods.name: SyncWrite
methods.description: Performs synchronous write to the endpoint.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the object type identifier for endpoint objects.

methods.name: endpoint_index
methods.description: Returns the endpoint index on the interface.

methods.name: GetParentInterfaceHandle
methods.description: Returns the handle of the parent interface.
